# What can be stored in My Aid Box

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Aug 28, 2025
- 2 min read

Updated: Sep 3, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_8f378b6730944bb28f4b79cdd1060ffa~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

A suitable storage for all the aid you need to prescribe across the Wasteland!

Included with membership in Fallout 1st. You must be an active Member to deposit aid items into the Aid Box.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Obtained via__

Atom Shop

Claim for free from the Fallout 1st Sub Menu

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_cda2ae236682479f928f27bd018026de~mv2.jpg)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_dffda8f8be9d495f8267bd3e75797fff~mv2.jpg)

Season 22 reward

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_14ae50e5f7ba47d89eaa2fe08469a373~mv2.jpg)

Reskins will likely become available in future Seasons or through the Atom Shop.

__World Spawns__

Similar to Scrap and Ammo Boxes, there are now Aid Box locations out in the world.

Ash Heap

Raid Camp outside of Gleaming Depths

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_80150c25f2f940f59df891b48d9202d9~mv2.jpg)

Ash Heap

One at every rest area in the Gleaming Depths Raids

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d8b54661b2194cea87169a28a83d805a~mv2.jpg)

Ash Heap

Nuka Cola On Tour

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d084dc5c641a4005aeff11d2aede6c01~mv2.jpg)

Savage Divide

Whitesprings Mall

Artisan's Corner

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_fc8f8320a7044cc798dc2cddf37ab8bc~mv2.jpg)

Skyline Valley

The Trading Post

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_3ffb109476904ce99dfca64e2f5e2913~mv2.jpg)
